dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Spontaneous periorbital ecchymosis due to vascular fragility, with associated central pendular torsional nystagmus secondary to a Chiari I malformation (in the context of a hereditary connective tissue disorder such as Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome)
ALTERNATIVE 1: AL (primary systemic) amyloidosis presenting with periorbital purpura and a rare or coincidental central nystagmus
ALTERNATIVE 2: Vitamin C deficiency (scurvy) causing spontaneous periorbital ecchymosis and a secondary nystagmus from an intracranial hemorrhage
ALTERNATIVE 3: Systemic vasculitis (e.g., Systemic Lupus Erythematosus or Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis) causing both cutaneous purpura and cerebral vasculitis
